title: Polarisation
design_rationale: Use transverse-wave understanding to motivate polarisation before Malus’s law.
concepts_taught: Relate plane polarisation to restriction of transverse oscillations.
Explain why longitudinal waves cannot be polarised in this sense.
Use I = I₀ cos²θ for plane-polarised electromagnetic waves.
Track the new plane and intensity through a sequence of polarising filters.
